card.name: The h inside biohazard
card.fires_on: The letter h in 'bio' + 'h' + 'azard(ous)' when disposal of contaminated materials is described. It also fires weakly just before 'hazardous' in phrases like 'potentially hazardous activities'.

modes.label: Biohazard disposal
modes.description: The split-off h in 'biohazard' or 'biohazardous' waste in handling and disposal instructions.
modes.example: Discard the outer gloves into a bio<<h>>azard waste container after use.

modes.label: Before 'hazardous' warnings
modes.description: A word or letter right before 'hazardous' in warnings about hazardous tasks or activities.
modes.example: WARNING: IMPAIRED ABILITY TO DRIVE OR ENGAGE IN OTHER POTENTIALLY<< H>>AZARDOUS ACTIVITIES
